ManualSliceRate.definition: The number of slices a manual slicer can cut per minute

AutomaticSliceRate.definition: The number of slices an automatic slicer can cut per minute

ManualGreaseRate.definition: The number of units of grease a manual slicer requires per minute

AutomaticGreaseRate.definition: The number of units of grease an automatic slicer requires per minute

MinimumSlicesPerMinute.definition: The minimum number of slices the shop needs to cut per minute

MaximumGreasePerMinute.definition: The maximum number of units of grease the shop can use per minute
